The smallest next experiment should represent an independently scheduled bounded
developmental trajectory and its contribution to effective disposition. Use the
qualified disposition/reason/decision path as the consumer. Hold learned history,
goals, current context and temporary impairment fixed while developmental state
changes; then hold developmental state fixed while acquired history changes.
Require changed actual decision probabilities and an actual choice witness where
the retained addressed seeds discriminate. Preserve equal sampled outcomes too.
